place.name: Córdoba, Spain
place.description: Córdoba ( KOR-də-bə; Spanish: [ˈkoɾðoβa] ), or sometimes Cordova ( KOR-də-və), is a city in Andalusia, Spain, and the capital of the province of Córdoba. With a population of 324,902 as of 2024, it is the 12th-largest city in Spain and the 3rd-largest in Andalusia.
